stories.title: Our ‘Paris manifesto’ proposes how to deal with extreme wealth in the AI age | Open letter
summary: It is possible for democracy to reverse the dynamic of oligarchy.

But we must act nowThe explosion of extreme wealth in the world is the defining social fact of our times.When Forbes magazine began ranking the world’s largest fortunes in 1987, the wealth of the richest 0.0001% of our planet’s population equaled 3% of global GDP.
Since that time, the wealth held by this tiny group of people – just 3,000 households – has ballooned and now reaches 17% of global GDP.
